title: play_character_as_attachment
description: The active player plays a character as an attachment during an action window, attached to a character in play of any player (Tattooed Wanderer, Togashi Kazue, Serene Ise Zumi…; Voice of the Ancestors from the dynasty discard pile): from where a character is played (a hand, a deck, a discard pile, a province, set aside), of any player. The card is an attachment while it is attached: it does not participate in conflicts, and its printed skills do not modify those of the character (glossary, Attachment Cards); it is discarded when that character leaves play, unless a player detaches it first (`detach_as_character`: Promising Youth). The player controls it, whoever owns it, and says what they pay (`card_cost`), since card effects may modify costs. The player resolves what follows with other actions, then ends their action (`end_resolution`), which ends their opportunity to act.

card_id.description: Character played as an attachment: in a hand, a deck, a discard pile, face up in a province, or set aside.

target_card_id.description: Character in play the card is attached to.
